reason: A proposes a more physically credible and directly testable heterostructure strategy: partial recrystallization after severe deformation can plausibly combine Hall–Petch strengthening with strain accommodation and crack blunting in coarse grains. Both proposals inadequately justify changing intrinsic Young’s modulus and lack alloy-specific evidence, but B additionally assumes that uniform deformation and aging will create a spatial gradient and that precipitates will inherently improve ductility and toughness, neither of which is well founded.
